The two tribal cases in this packet (Fallon Paiute-Shoshone, Pyramid Lake Paiute) are not in the inventory: the coordinator already removed them as permanent bans (work/answers/rejected/coordinator-permanent-bans-2026-09-23.json), which agrees with the trackers, so they get no decision here.
